title.cn: 兰桂坊：噪音里的社交副本
title.en: Lan Kwai Fong: Social Dungeon in Noise

text.cn: 酒吧街噪音与酒气。你可以社交，也可以社恐。有人用三种语言点单，有人只点手指。
text.en: Bar street noise and booze air. Social or socially anxious — your call. Someone orders in three languages; someone only points.
One drink then leave: controlled social.

feedback.cn: 你完成了「来过」。耳朵还在，肝也还在。
feedback.en: Check-in complete. Ears intact; liver intact.

feedback.cn: 你们交换路线与避坑经验。酒精是催化剂，故事是真正的消费。
feedback.en: You trade routes and scam tips. Alcohol is catalyst; stories are the real spend.

feedback.cn: 社恐胜利。安静的空调声听起来像天籁。
feedback.en: Social anxiety wins. Hotel AC sounds like heaven.

text.cn: 兰桂坊夜结束。嗓子哑了，故事多了。
text.en: LKF night ends. Throat hoarse; stories denser.
